title: feat(nm2frm1ssl): directed 1-step cyclic-frame transport along -e3 at t+1 on two-axis same-lock seed: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Same-lock seed (+e1,+e1,+e2,+e2) with the -e3 1-step. The seed change costs the face pair: (0,0,1) now has M={+e_2} with O covering all three axes, so its split fails. Recomputed: bits hold/hold on reverse, fail/hold on face. Its not-leftover gate genuinely recomputes the opposite-seed rival and asserts the difference.
